detailZones.title: Counterbalance forklift
detailZones.description: Inspect the complete forklift, its lifting assembly, operator area, wheels and rear body.

detailZones.title: Pallet rack storage
detailZones.description: Follow the rack structure, pallets, containers and secured loads along the storage aisle.

detailZones.title: Material-handling equipment
detailZones.description: Inspect manual and powered pallet trucks, the rolling ladder and protective barriers.

detailZones.title: Packing and dispatch station
detailZones.description: Explore the packing bench, conveyor, scales, scanners, containers and hand truck.

detailZones.title: Truck loading dock
detailZones.description: Inspect the dock door, trailer threshold, safety fixtures, access stair and emergency equipment.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 warehouse photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It supports independently pointable forklift parts, rack structure, pallets and containers, manual and powered handling equipment, packing hardware, dock components and emergency fixtures. Hidden inventory data, shipping operations, hazards, compliance claims, movements and worker roles are excluded.
